label: HPE ProLiant ML350 Gen11 4U tower server
description: 4U two-socket tower server with no embedded LOM: the default configuration carries a Broadcom BCM5719 1Gb 4-port BASE-T OCP 3.0 adapter plus a dedicated 1GbE iLO 6 management port, and a second OCP 3.0 slot plus up to 10 PCIe 5.0 slots stay free for faster NICs.

label: HPE ProLiant DL20 Gen11 1U short-depth server
description: 1U short-depth single-socket rack server with an embedded Broadcom BCM5719 1Gb 4-port BASE-T controller; iLO 6 shares embedded port 1 by default, and a separate dedicated 1GbE iLO port only exists if the optional Serial Port/iLO/M.2 enablement kit is fitted.

label: PowerEdge R360 1U rack server
description: 1U single-socket rack server with 2x 1GbE LOM ports on the system board (port 1 doubles as the local management port) plus a separate dedicated 1GbE iDRAC Ethernet port; the two PCIe slots take optional 4x 1GbE or 2x/4x 10GbE network cards.

label: ThinkSystem SR665 V3 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket AMD EPYC rack server whose base configuration has only the dedicated 1GbE RJ-45 XCC systems-management port; the optional OCP 3.0 module adds 2 or 4 Ethernet ports and up to 12 PCIe 5.0 slots remain free for stand-up adapters.

label: Hyper A+ AS-2015HS-TNR 2U rack server
description: 2U single-socket AMD EPYC 9004/9005 Hyper server with no onboard data NICs: the base configuration has only the 1x RJ45 1GbE dedicated BMC LAN port, while data networking comes from the single PCIe 5.0 x16 AIOM slot (OCP NIC 3.0 compatible) plus the optional PCIe slots.

label: Cisco UCS C240 M7 2U rack server
description: 2U two-socket rack server whose base server ships with a single dedicated 1Gbase-T RJ-45 management port for the CIMC; the one modular mLOM/OCP 3.0 slot (x16) and up to 8 PCIe 4.0 or 4 PCIe 5.0 slots are free for 10/25/50/100/200G VIC or OCP adapters.

label: Cisco UCS C220 M7 1U rack server
description: 1RU two-socket rack server with a single 1Gbase-T RJ-45 dedicated management port for the CIMC as its only base network port; one modular mLOM/OCP 3.0 slot provides up to 2x 100GbE and up to 3 PCIe 4.0 or 2 PCIe 5.0 slots remain free.

label: QNAP TS-453E 4-bay desktop NAS
description: 4-bay long-life-cycle desktop NAS with 2x 2.5GbE RJ-45 ports (2.5G/1G/100M) and no separate management interface, so QTS administration runs in-band over the 2.5G links.

label: QNAP TS-832PX 8-bay desktop NAS with 10GbE
description: 8-bay desktop NAS with 2x 2.5GbE RJ-45 ports plus 2x 10GbE SFP+ ports on board, and no dedicated management port - QTS is managed in-band over any of the data ports.

label: QNAP TS-433 4-bay desktop NAS
description: 4-bay ARM-based desktop NAS with 1x 1GbE RJ-45 port and 1x 2.5GbE RJ-45 port (2.5G/1G/100M) out of the box; there is no dedicated management port, QTS runs in-band.

label: ASUSTOR FLASHSTOR 6 (FS6706T) 6-bay M.2 NVMe NAS
description: 6-bay all-flash M.2 NVMe desktop NAS with dual 2.5-Gigabit Ethernet ports and no dedicated management port, so ADM is administered in-band over the 2.5G links.

label: TrueNAS R50 4U hybrid storage appliance
description: 4U (scalable to 12U) hybrid storage appliance whose base configuration has 2x SFP+ 10/25/40/100GbE ports plus a dedicated 1GBase-T OOBM management port; copper 10GBase-T and 32Gb Fibre Channel are optional add-in cards.

label: TrueNAS Mini R 12-bay rackmount NAS
description: 12-bay rackmount NAS with 2x RJ-45 1/10GBase-T Ethernet LAN ports as standard plus a dedicated RJ45 IPMI port for out-of-band hardware management.
